name: Welcome To Bon's Burgers
summary: Welcome to Bon's Burgers is a cancelled indie-horror game, based off the hit game series Five Nights at Freddy's, that preceded The Walten Files. The first act of the game is available for download, along with the scrapped Act 2. The other acts are currently lost besides its Halloween game, Night of the Living Robot. Many of the elements seen in the game appear in the VHS series, such as the characters, settings, and story.
